title: Coquitlam road work is affecting Parkway and Panorama
sourceName: City of Coquitlam road work notice
commercialFitReason: Road-work updates serve recurring commuter and local-service planning intent, which may support contextual local ads; page views, ad revenue, RPM, and sponsor demand remain unavailable.
lengthRationale: A bulletin is the shortest complete format because the reader needs the location, hours, timing, and traffic impact, not a broader transportation explainer.

evidence.readerImpact: Drivers using Parkway Boulevard and Panorama Drive can plan extra travel time or choose another route while intersection work continues.
evidence.freshnessEvidence: City notice posted July 19, 2026; work is underway and expected to continue through late August.
evidence.uniqueAngleEvidence: Existing published local inventory has no Coquitlam road-work bulletin and no Parkway/Panorama route-planning update.
